title: SFBond 실버폭스 #088 · 바디페인팅(공예 Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer) · 사지를 뒤로 당김 · Yoruba Nigerian · early 40s · 헤어 low bun · 자유축 Core
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Yoruba Nigerian woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a calm, distant gaze, silver-white hair styled in low bun, real living eyes. Long square nails, glittery finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer — glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines, wide mother-of-pearl bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her body below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line. A faint streak of soot crosses her cheekbone, and a little grime darkens her fingertips and the soles of her bare feet.

Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a thick chain of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, back and down to its own huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall behind her at hip height on its own side. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a thick chain of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, back to its own huge black iron ring set in the flagstone floor at the base of the wall behind her, all four chains pulled dead taut.

Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her torso leaning forward against the pull of the chains behind her, her arms drawn back and down along her sides, her shoulders pulled back, her head bowed slightly, her bare feet flat on the flagstones, her whole body straining, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes.

Background & Lighting: dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her, catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
